programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E2

Temen Ngekost S1 E3

programme.title: The Natural Way To Hold A Golf Club To Hit Straight Shots

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E5
programme.desc: Kai iri dengan Rafi yang baru pulang berlibur dari Bali bersama ibunya. Disaat yang tepat, Kai mendapatkan info lomba video yang berhadiah staycation di Bali untuk dua orang. Kai pun berusaha membuat video tentang kehidupan sekitarnya dengan merekam semua momen yang ada di Kostan South House.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E6
programme.desc: Suasana di rumah kos menjadi sepi dan tidak nyaman lagi. Semua orang sibuk dengan urusan masing-masing. Sementara Kai yang belum mendapatkan pekerjaan tetap berpegang pada idealismenya bahwa lebih baik tidak bekerja daripada bekerja di bidang yang tidak ia sukai.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E7
programme.desc: Babe Yasmin meminta tolong pada Jaki, kakak angkat Yasmin yang berasal dari Jakarta Timur untuk merubah aturan kos menjadi lebih disiplin. Namun aturan yang dibuat membuat anak-anak South House terganggu dan terkekang. Mereka yang merasa kesal berusaha mengusir Jaki dari kostan.

programme.title: Carly Booth Came To Play - The Grove GC Part 1
Temen Ngekost S1 E8
programme.desc: Rumah kos South House adalah tempat di mana Yasmin, Kai, Rafi, Dian, dan Opay tinggal bersama. Mereka memiliki latar belakang dan profesi yang berbeda-beda. Mereka adalah perwujudan dari gagasan bahwa suka dan duka dalam hidup sebaiknya dinikmati dan dibagi bersama. Begitulah cara mereka berusaha bertahan dan belajar untuk saling memahami satu sama lain.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E9
programme.desc: Pertengkaran terjadi antara Yasmin dan Babe. Yasmin ingin melanjutkan studi ke luar negeri dan telah menerima undangan wawancara beasiswa. Namun, Babe ingin Yasmin menjadi penyanyi dangdut seperti ibunya. Hal ini sangat bertentangan dengan impian Yasmin yang menyukai K-pop. Pertengkaran tersebut membuat Yasmin kabur dari rumah kos bersama Kai.

programme.title: Expensive £250 Rangefinder vs Free GPS Iphone App
Temen Ngekost S1 E10
programme.desc: Para penghuni rumah kos akhirnya bisa mengadakan pesta ala anak-anak Jakarta Selatan untuk merayakan kelulusan Yasmin dan Rafi. Saat pesta berlangsung, pengumuman tentang diterimanya Yasmin di sebuah universitas di Korea keluar. Pesta yang seharusnya penuh kesenangan pun berubah menjadi pesta perpisahan untuk Yasmin.

programme.title: Pain Free Golf Swing - My First Ever Swing Lesson - Back To Basics
Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E14
programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi adalah program televisi yang mengubah rumah tidak layak huni milik keluarga kurang mampu menjadi tempat tinggal yang aman dan nyaman, sekaligus menghadirkan kisah perjuangan dan harapan baru bagi penghuninya.

programme.title: Playing Golf Using Only One Arm - Challenge
Roy & Marten Sahabat Sehidup Semati S1 E1
programme.desc: Roy, seorang politisi yang sedang mengalami kesulitan keuangan untuk pencalonannya. Ia bermimpi bertemu dengan almarhum ayahnya yang punya tabungan crypto. Supaya bisa mendapatkan password akun crypto sang ayah, Roy meminta bantuan Marten, sahabatnya yang indigo untuk membuka mata batinnya.

programme.title: Hunt For Family Court Killer
programme.desc: Pembunuhan, terorisme, dan pembunuhan berencana diselidiki kembali oleh seorang Kepala Inspektur perempuan yang gigih. Selama 40 tahun, sebuah bab kelam kejahatan yang dilakukan atas nama nilai-nilai keluarga tetap belum terpecahkan. Dengan menggunakan berbagai arsip serta tiga sudut pandang yang saling melengkapi—para korban, kepolisian, dan lembaga peradilan—serial dokumenter ini menggali konteks sosial dan politik pada masa tersebut. Serial yang kuat dan menarik ini mengungkap kasus terorisme dalam negeri pada 1980-an, kekerasan dalam rumah tangga, serta meningkatnya kelompok-kelompok pria konservatif sebagai respons terhadap Family Court yang progresif. Kisah ini mengungkap bab mengejutkan dalam sejarah sosial Australia yang ternyata masih memiliki relevansi yang mengkhawatirkan hingga saat ini.

programme.title: The Season So Far : The Catch-Up Show
programme.desc: We look back at all the very best moments of the 2026/2027 season?so?far. An action-packed show filled with exciting Premier League programming and digital content.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.title: Goalkeeping With Petr Cech : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

The Little Magician became a trailblazer as one of the Premier League's first genuine flair players, and by the time of his departure seven seasons later, he had established himself as an all-time great at Stamford Bridge.

programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Cech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: (Subbed) Diogo Jota : PL Stories
programme.desc: One year on from the tragic death of Diogo Jota and his brother Andre in a car accident, this deeply emotional PL Stories show celebrates the life of one of football's most loved figures. Through interviews with friends, teammates and coaches from Portugal to the Premier League, we look back on Jota's journey, the impact he had on those around him, and the legacy he left behind both on and off the pitch.

Bara yang sedang mengemudi, kaget ketika mengetahui keberadaan Rena di dalam mobilnya. Bara segera menghentikan mobilnya. Bara menuduh Rena adalah seorang pembegal mobil. Rena tidak terima. Keduanya terlibat percekcokan. Kemudian, Bara yang diminta papanya untuk mendapatkan kebun strawberry milik ayah Rena, terpaksa harus mendekati Rena. Awalnya Bara dan Rena sering cekcok, tapi lama kelamaan Bara mulai menyukai Rena yang baik hati, padahal ia sudah punya tunangan bernama Sheila.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Kura Kura Dalam Perahu Pura Pura Punya Pacar Baru
programme.desc: Vanka mengikuti acara kemping dengan teman-temannya di sebuah perbukitan. Saat sedang hiking, tiba-tiba Vanka terpeleset dan masuk jurang. Ia meminta pertolongan, tapi tidak ada yang mendengarnya. Teman-teman Vanka baru menyadari Vanka bilang saat mereka berkumpul dan pemimpin regu menanyakan keberadaan Vanka. Pada saat Vanka sedang kesusahan, datang seorang pria muda yang membantunya. Pria yang memakai tongkat tersebut merasa sangat kasihan melihat kondisi Vanka yang lemas dan kakinya tidak bisa berjalan.

programme.title: Petantang Petenteng Pas Ditantang Malah Bikin Mupeng
programme.desc: Wicaksana atau Wicak sedang mencari ibunya di desa. Namun ia bertemu dengan Nindi, penjaga villa tempatnya menginap. Wicak dan Nindi bersama keliling desa mencari informasi tentang ibunya. Dalam perjalanannya Wicak dan Nindi menemukan kenyamanan satu-sama lain.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: Kesempatan terakhir seorang komedian veteran untuk menjadi bintang membawanya ke jalan bersama seorang komedian muda yang mengungkap masa lalu yang tak terduga.

programme.title: The Folks
programme.desc: Setelah pemakaman suaminya, Mary menerima kunjungan dari saudara laki-laki dan ibunya, yang belum pernah ia temui sebelumnya. Mary mengetahui bahwa kerabat mendiang suaminya berbahaya bagi dirinya dan putranya, Tony.

programme.title: Havenhurst
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda nan bermasalah tinggal di sebuah apartemen tua tempat ia harus menghadapi sesosok iblis yang mengerikan.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1876, seorang pemburu bayaran melacak saudaranya sendiri di seluruh Montana dengan bantuan seorang pemburu hewan ilegal.

programme.title: Road To Hell
programme.desc: Seorang prajurit yang telah lama berperang menjadi gila karena ia tidak lagi percaya pada tujuan atau kebenaran di balik pembunuhan itu. Ia pulang ke dunia surealis, mencari cinta pertamanya dan satu-satunya dari masa mudanya, percaya bahwa wanita itu akan menyelamatkannya dari iblis-iblis dalam dirinya. Dalam perjalanan menuju Edge City, ia bertemu dengan dua pembunuh berantai yang menggoda dan menentang upayanya untuk menemukan cintanya dan penebusan yang sangat ia dambakan.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: Di Barat yang tak ada aturan hukum, The Cowboys, kakak-beradik pembunuh dan pencuri nan terkenal, menguasai wilayah tersebut dengan tinju brutal dan senjata api. Namun, takdir akhirnya datang menghampiri mereka.

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Lewis Cutterman, dokter bedah terhormat, menyimpan rahasia kelam. Keluarganya membius tamu lalu memakan tubuhnya sedikit demi sedikit untuk memperdagangkan organ demi pasien kaya.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Seorang kurir khusus ditugaskan untuk mengirim sebuah kotak misterius ke dunia pembunuh bayaran nan berbahaya.

programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: Ketika matriark dari sebuah keluarga pembunuh bayaran jatuh sakit, ketiga anaknya dan pacarnya yang lebih muda saling berebut untuk mengambil alih kerajaan bisnisnya.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Seorang petani menampung seorang pria yang terluka dengan tas berisi uang tunai. Ketika sekelompok orang datang untuk mengambil uang itu, dia harus memutuskan siapa yang bisa dipercaya. Saat mempertahankan diri dari pengepungan, dia mengungkapkan bakatnya sebagai penembak jitu yang membuat identitas aslinya dipertanyakan.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
The Ballad Of Davy Crockett
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1815, seorang Legenda Amerika, yang istrinya jatuh sakit parah, meninggalkan anak-anaknya yang masih kecil untuk bertahan hidup sendirian, harus berjuang untuk kembali menemui mereka melewati banyak bahaya yang ditemukan di Savage Lands di daerah perbatasan yang liar.

programme.title: The Lurking Fear
programme.desc: Ketika kru TV merekam sebuah reality show di sebuah rumah sakit jiwa yang terbengkalai, mereka bertemu dengan gerombolan iblis, yang menyebabkan pertarungan berdarah untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Berlatar saat Perang Dunia II, sekelompok tentara Angkatan Darat Amerika dikirim dalam misi rahasia untuk menemukan komandan mereka yang hilang.

programme.title: The Curse Of Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Seorang pria mewarisi rumah leluhurnya dan sebuah kutukan kuno yang berasal dari Perang Salib.

programme.title: Pineapple Express
programme.desc: Seorang pengantar surat panggilan pengadilan dan pengedar ganja miliknya akhirnya menjadi buronan para pembunuh bayaran dan seorang polisi korup setelah ia menyaksikan bos pengedarnya membunuh seorang pesaing saat mencoba mengantarkan surat panggilan pengadilan kepadanya.

programme.title: Black And Blue (Galaxy Premium)

programme.title: Hidden Cities Extreme S2, Ep 1
programme.desc: Musim kedua Hidden Cities Extreme menghadirkan petualangan yang lebih berani saat Simon Yin menjelajahi berbagai negara di Asia untuk merasakan langsung tradisi dan kebiasaan yang tidak biasa. Mulai dari berburu tikus di Filipina, menyelam bebas di Indonesia, meminum urine sapi di India, mengikuti balap unta di Mongolia Dalam, hingga berlatih menjadi ninja di Jepang, setiap perjalanan memperlihatkan sisi budaya yang jarang diketahui wisatawan. Dengan berinteraksi langsung bersama masyarakat setempat, serial ini mengungkap kisah-kisah unik dan pengalaman ekstrem yang memperlihatkan keberagaman budaya Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

KESERUAN DAN KEAJAIBAN MENANTI DI BAWAH PERMUKAAN LAUT!

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 24: MASTER JOURNEYS
programme.desc: "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH SALAH SATU SERI TERBARU DALAM FRANCHISE POKEMON YANG MELANJUTKAN PERJALANAN ASH KETCHUM SEBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON. SERI INI MENAMPILKAN PETUALANGAN ASH BERSAMA DENGAN TEMANNYA, PIKACHU, DALAM MENJELAJAHI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON YANG BERBEDA. MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN BERBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON BARU, MENANTANG GYM LEADERS, DAN MENGHADAPI TIM ROCKET YANG SELALU INGIN MENCURI POKEMON. SALAH SATU FOKUS UTAMA DARI "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH PENJELAJAHAN DUNIA POKEMON YANG LUAS. ASH DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA BERTUJUAN UNTUK MENGHADIRI WORLD CORONATION SERIES, SEBUAH KOMPETISI BESAR DI MANA MEREKA BERUSAHA UNTUK MENJADI JUARA POKEMON MASTER. DI SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN POKEMON LEGENDARIS, MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN BARU, DAN BELAJAR LEBIH BANYAK TENTANG DUNIA POKEMON. SERI INI JUGA MENGEKSPLORASI DINAMIKA ANTARA ASH, PIKACHU, DAN KARAKTER-KARAKTER LAIN YANG MEREKA TEMUI DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA. DENGAN FOKUS PADA PERTUMBUHAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN KEKUATAN TIM, "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" MENYAJIKAN PETUALANGAN YANG SERU DAN PENUH DENGAN KEJUTAN BAGI PARA PENGGEMAR POKEMON.

programme.desc: Madun

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (EXTINCTION)
programme.desc: MOHSEN, SI PENGGEMAR SUPERHERO, BERTEMU DENGAN TIGY, SEEKOR ANAK HARIMAU LANGKA YANG SEDANG DIBURU! DIAM-DIAM, MOHSEN MEMBAWA TIGY KE RUMAHNYA DI KOTA UNTUK MENYELAMATKANNYA. MISI BERBAHAYA MEREKA BERNAMA 'MENYELAMATKAN HARIMAU MALAYA TERAKHIR' AKAN MENGUJI KEBERANIAN DAN PERSAHABATAN MEREKA. SETELAH BERHASIL MENGEMBALIKAN TIGY KE HUTAN, MOHSEN SADAR IA HARUS MENJADI PAHLAWAN SEJATI UNTUK MELINDUNGI ALAM. TONTON KISAH SERU INI YANG MEMBUKTIKAN BAHWA ANAK BIASA BISA JADI LUAR BIASA!

programme.title: Pokemon
programme.desc: Pokemon

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 24: MASTER JOURNEYS
programme.desc: "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH SALAH SATU SERI TERBARU DALAM FRANCHISE POKEMON YANG MELANJUTKAN PERJALANAN ASH KETCHUM SEBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON. SERI INI MENAMPILKAN PETUALANGAN ASH BERSAMA DENGAN TEMANNYA, PIKACHU, DALAM MENJELAJAHI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON YANG BERBEDA. MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN BERBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON BARU, MENANTANG GYM LEADERS, DAN MENGHADAPI TIM ROCKET YANG SELALU INGIN MENCURI POKEMON. SALAH SATU FOKUS UTAMA DARI "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH PENJELAJAHAN DUNIA POKEMON YANG LUAS. ASH DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA BERTUJUAN UNTUK MENGHADIRI WORLD CORONATION SERIES, SEBUAH KOMPETISI BESAR DI MANA MEREKA BERUSAHA UNTUK MENJADI JUARA POKEMON MASTER. DI SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN POKEMON LEGENDARIS, MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN BARU, DAN BELAJAR LEBIH BANYAK TENTANG DUNIA POKEMON. SERI INI JUGA MENGEKSPLORASI DINAMIKA ANTARA ASH, PIKACHU, DAN KARAKTER-KARAKTER LAIN YANG MEREKA TEMUI DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA. DENGAN FOKUS PADA PERTUMBUHAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN KEKUATAN TIM, "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" MENYAJIKAN PETUALANGAN YANG SERU DAN PENUH DENGAN KEJUTAN BAGI PARA PENGGEMAR POKEMON.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Keluarga Somat

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Just For Laughs
programme.desc: Sebuah acara komedi bisu Kanada yang dibuat oleh grup Just For Laughs. Acara ini menampilkan orang-orang yang dijebak dalam berbagai situasi aneh oleh para aktor sementara sebuah kamera tersembunyi merekam reaksi mereka.

programme.title: MINIBODS
programme.desc: SELAMAT DATANG DI DUNIA MINIBODS! BERSAMA VERSI KECIL DARI KARAKTER ODDBODS YANG IKONIK, SAKSIKAN PETUALANGAN SERU DAN LUCU MEREKA. MELALUI BERMAIN DAN TAWA, PARA SAHABAT INI BELAJAR BEKERJA SAMA DAN MEMECAHKAN MASALAH DENGAN CARA YANG SANGAT MENGHIBUR.

programme.title: BABY ZU
programme.desc: Saksikan keseruan momo, cici, blu dan geng. menemani tumbuh kembangmu, generasi emas indonesia untuk dunia!

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES ADALAH SERIAL ANIMASI RUSIA YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN PARA "FIXIES," MAKHLUK KECIL YANG HIDUP DI DALAM PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK. MEREKA MEMPERBAIKI MASALAH TEKNOLOGI SEHARI-HARI SAMBIL MENGAJARKAN PENONTON TENTANG SAINS DAN TEKNOLOGI SECARA MENYENANGKAN. SERIAL INI DIRANCANG UNTUK ANAK-ANAK UNTUK BELAJAR TENTANG PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK DAN PENTINGNYA PERAWATANNYA.

programme.desc: Peek-a-boo, program edukasi yang dirancang khusus untuk bayi dan balita berusia 0 hingga 2 tahun. Setiap episode berdurasi 15 menit dan menampilkan berbagai karakter lucu, seperti anjing berbulu putih dan boneka berwarna cerah, yang dirancang untuk menarik perhatian dan merangsang perkembangan sensorik anak.

programme.title: With Mother

programme.title: 1-Minute Anime: Songs For SDGs

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terlanjur Mencintaimu

programme.title: Terlanjur Mencintaimu (RCTI)

programme.title: Microdrama + : Cinta Tanpa Status

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Putri Pewaris

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Aina, mahasiswi sekaligus SPG, tak sengaja berkonflik dengan Darel setelah mengunggah aksinya yang viral di media sosial. Tanpa mereka sadari, Darel adalah anak Ferdi, pria yang merebut perusahaan sekaligus membunuh ayah Aina 20 tahun lalu. Perseteruan Aina dan Darel semakin rumit setelah sebuah kejadian membuat mereka nyaris dinikahkan, hingga kebencian perlahan berubah menjadi cinta. Namun, akankah cinta mereka bertahan ketika rahasia kelam kedua keluarga mulai terungkap?

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Mimpi bahagia Arina (Febby Rastanty) berubah jadi ancaman saat hari pernikahannya bersama Reno (Randy Jhon) dihancurkan oleh Fico (Rangga Azof) yang dikuasai dendam keluarga! saksikan kisahnya dalam sinetron terbaru biarkan hati bicara

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. Saat ia akhirnya menemukan harapan melalui pernikahan dengan pria yang dicintainya, takdir justru mempertemukannya dengan sebuah pengkhianatan yang mengubah hidupnya. Terjebak dalam keluarga yang dipenuhi dendam, rahasia, dan kebencian, Arina harus mengungkap kebenaran sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: FTV Primetime
programme.desc: Film televisi yang mengangkat kisah romantisme kehidupan dengan konflik yang menarik. Tayang setiap hari.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Boleh Ngutang
programme.desc: Gimana rasanya ya kalau ada tukang kredit cantik kayak Ana (Pamela Bowie)? Pasti Denis (Bhisma Mulia) makin pengen ngutang terus deh biar digangguin terus

programme.title: Arafta: Terbelenggu Takdir
programme.desc: Ates terjebak antara obsesi balas dendam dan cintanya pada Mercan. Saat niat menghancurkan berubah jadi rasa, sanggupkah ia memilih kedamaian?

programme.title: Sinema Dini Hari

programme.title: Barakallah
programme.desc: Setiap episode dihadirkan bersama pembawa acara dan bintang tamu yang berbagi kisah, pengalaman, dan solusi berdasarkan ajaran Islam mulai dari masalah rumah tangga, persahabatan, hingga tantangan sosial modern.

programme.title: Buser
programme.desc: Buser adalah program berita kriminal yang menyoroti berbagai kasus kejahatan yang terjadi di Indonesia.

programme.desc: Menyapa Indonesia Siang di Sin Po TV adalah program berita dan informasi yang memperbarui pemirsa di tengah hari. Acara ini merangkum peristiwa penting sejak pagi dan menyoroti isu-isu hangat. Program ini menyajikan berita nasional dan internasional, ekonomi, laporan langsung, serta analisis isu politik, sosial, dan budaya, seringkali dengan wawancara narasumber. programme.title: Menyapa Indonesia Petang
programme.desc: Menyapa Indonesia Petang di Sin Po TV adalah program berita utama sore hari yang merangkum seluruh peristiwa penting sepanjang hari. Acara ini memberikan gambaran komprehensif tentang dinamika politik, ekonomi, sosial, dan budaya di Indonesia dan dunia. Setiap episode menyajikan berita terkini, laporan mendalam, dan analisis dari ahli, serta update isu hangat, cuaca, dan segmen inspiratif. Dengan penyampaian yang padat informasi dan mudah dicerna, program ini membekali pemirsa dengan pemahaman menyeluruh tentang perkembangan terkini di penghujung hari.

programme.title: Menyapa Indonesia Malam
programme.desc: Menyapa Indonesia Malam di Sin Po TV adalah program berita penutup hari yang merangkum dan menganalisis peristiwa penting sepanjang hari. programme.title: Missing You (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang gadis kecil yang kehilangan ayahnya karena seorang pembunuh berantai 15 tahun yang lalu menunggu pembebasannya, sementara seorang detektif yang dicurigai mengikuti si pembunuh setelah dibebaskan.

programme.title: The Snitch (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Dalam lingkaran kejahatan narkoba, informan 'Ya-Dang' menjual informasi kriminal. Penjahat menggunakannya untuk mengurangi hukuman, sementara penegak hukum menggunakannya untuk penangkapan. Ya-Dang, polisi, dan jaksa membentuk segitiga kunci.

programme.title: The First Ride
programme.desc: Empat sahabat seumur hidup—Tae Jeong, Do Jin, Yeon Min, dan Geum Bok—bermimpi melakukan perjalanan epik ke luar negeri, tetapi kehidupan menghalangi. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, lebih tua tetapi belum tentu lebih bijak, mereka akhirnya memulai perjalanan yang sudah lama tertunda.

programme.title: Samjin Company English Class
programme.desc: Pada pertengahan tahun 1990-an di Korea Selatan, tiga pegawai wanita yang mendaftar ke kelas Bahasa Inggris dengan harapan dapat memajukan karier mereka, berjuang untuk mengungkap korupsi di dalam perusahaan mereka.

programme.title: Steel Rain: Summit
programme.desc: Pertemuan perdamaian untuk Korea gagal saat pemimpin Korea Selatan, Korea Utara, dan Amerika Serikat diculik dan disandera di sebuah kapal selam oleh sekelompok ekstremis Korea Utara.

programme.title: The President's Barber
programme.desc: Sung Han-Mo, seorang tukang cukur yang tinggal di lingkungan kediaman Presiden Korea Selatan, Hyoja-dong. Dia dipercaya menjadi tukang cukur pribadi sang Presiden setelah dibodohi Cha Jhi Cul kepala keamanan presiden. Namun. menjadi seorang tukang cukur Presiden membuat hidupnya semakin runyam.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh yang kecewa menerima satu serangan terakhir dengan harapan dapat menggunakan penghasilannya untuk mengembalikan penglihatan seorang penyanyi yang secara tidak sengaja dibutakannya.

programme.title: The Moon
programme.desc: Seorang astronaut terdampar di luar angkasa karena sebuah kecelakaan saat melakukan penerbangan luar angkasa. Mantan direktur pusat antariksa pun berusaha keras untuk membawanya kembali ke bumi dengan selamat.

programme.title: The World Of Love
programme.desc: Jooin, seorang siswi berusia 17 tahun yang bingung dengan cinta, melepaskan kekacauan dengan beberapa kata yang diucapkan dalam momen kemarahan. Surat-surat anonim yang mempertanyakan tindakannya mulai berdatangan, mengubah kehidupan tenangnya.

programme.title: One Win (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Tentang seorang pelatih yang kurang sukses yang dipasangkan dengan tim bola voli putri yang selalu kalah dan hanya membutuhkan satu kemenangan agar pemiliknya dapat mempertahankan tim tersebut.

programme.title: The King (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Kisah seorang jaksa muda yang naik jabatan dengan cepat, tetapi jatuh lebih cepat lagi.

programme.desc: Setelah dipecat, seorang pria menyusun rencana unik untuk mendapatkan pekerjaan baru: menyingkirkan para pesaingnya.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Hitcher II: I've Been Waiting
programme.desc: In the first of Bud Abbott and Lou Costello's horror vehicles for Universal Pictures, the inimitable comic duo star as railway baggage handlers in northern Florida. When a pair of crates belonging to a house of horrors museum are mishandled by Wilbur (Lou Costello), the museum's director, Mr. McDougal (Frank Ferguson), demands that they deliver them personally so that they can be inspected for insurance purposes, but Lou's friend Chick (Bud Abbott) has grave suspicions.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: After a comet disrupts the rain cycle of Earth, the planet has become a desolate, barren desert by the year 2033. With resources scarce, Kesslee (Malcolm McDowell) -- head of the powerful and evil Water & Power Corporation, the de facto government -- has taken control of the water supply. Unwilling to cower under Kesslee's tyrannical rule, a pair of outlaws known as Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and Jet Girl (Naomi Watts) rise up, joining the mysterious rebel Rippers to destroy the corrupt system.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
programme.desc: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

programme.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
programme.desc: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: A monstrous storm devastates Los Angeles, leaving the streets flooded and infested with sharks.

programme.title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
programme.desc: A freak weather system turns its deadly fury on New York City, unleashing a Sharknado on the population and its most cherished, iconic sites - and only Fin and April can save the Big Apple.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

programme.title: Solstice
programme.desc: While vacationing with friends, a teenager (Elisabeth Harnois) believes that her dead twin sister is trying to contact her.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

programme.title: Hair
programme.desc: In New York City for the first time while on his way to enlist in the U.S. Army during the Vietnam War, Oklahoma farm hand Claude Hooper Bukowski (John Savage) meets up with a freewheeling group of Central Park hippies led by the irrepressible George Berger (Treat Williams). When the unlikely friends meet upper-middle-class debutante Sheila Franklin (Beverly D'Angelo), sparks fly between the country boy and the city girl, and Berger's troupe attempts to keep the young lovers together.

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: One year after accidentally scaring his fiancée to death, a young man (Jason Biggs) heeds his friend's advice and begins dating again. He hurriedly proposes to a waitress (Isla Fisher), but she has issues of her own, including a pair of problematic parents (Joe Pantoliano, Joanna Gleason).

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Crime boss Bart raises orphan Danny with no knowledge of anything other than how to fight, using him as an enforcer when debts must be collected. Planning to enter Danny into a fight tournament and retire with the prize money, Bart disappears after a deadly drive-by shooting. Danny flees and takes shelter with piano tuner Sam. Away from Bart's abusive control, Danny learns how to live like a human and begins investigating his past.

programme.title: Backdraft
programme.desc: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case.

programme.title: Backdraft 2
programme.desc: A fire investigator with the Chicago Fire Department tracks an arms dealer who uses deadly fires as a distraction.

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: A group of armed robbers fleeing the police head for the New Jersey Tunnel and run right into trucks transporting toxic waste. The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.

programme.title: Street Fighter
programme.desc: Gen. Bison (Raul Julia), the evil dictator of Shadaloo, captures a busload of relief workers and holds them for ransom. Col. Guile (Jean-Claude Van Damme) leads an international strike force to invade Shadaloo and rescue the hostages. Along the way, Guile recruits Chun-Li (Ming-Na Wen), a reporter and martial-arts expert whose father was killed by Bison years ago, two young con men (Damian Chapa, Byron Mann) and a sumo wrestler (Peter Navy Tuiasosopo).

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
programme.desc: After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: In this action-comedy, unusual circumstances find big, brawny cop John Kimble (Arnold Schwarzenegger) posing as a kindergarten teacher in order to apprehend major drug lord Cullen Crisp (Richard Tyson), as well as his ruthless accomplice and mother, Eleanor (Carroll Baker). While pretending to be a kid-friendly instructor, Kimble falls for pretty fellow teacher Joyce Palmieri (Penelope Ann Miller) as he battles both unruly children and dangerous bad guys.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: Thunderbirds
programme.desc: Former astronaut Jeff Tracy (Bill Paxton) runs International Rescue, a top-secret heroic organization, from his headquarters on Tracy Island. The island also houses the futuristic vehicles created by Ray "Brains" Hackenbacker (Anthony Edwards). But while Jeff is on a mission in space, his nemesis, The Hood (Ben Kingsley), invades Tracy Island. The Hood plots to use the island's technology for evil, and only Jeff's son, Alan (Brady Corbet), can stop him.

programme.title: Undercover Brother
programme.desc: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Partnered with the sassy, stunning Sistah Girl, our hero must first undergo the ultimate attitude adjustment and trade in his 'fro and platforms for tennis sweaters and penny loafers. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash.

programme.title: Alpha Dog
programme.desc: Teenage dealer Johnny Truelove (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother (Anton Yelchin) of a junkie (Ben Foster) who refuses to pay his drug debt. Things change unexpectedly when Frankie (Justin Timberlake), one of Johnny's pals, befriends the youth.

programme.title: Slither
programme.desc: Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

programme.title: Devil
programme.desc: Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. programme.title: The Raccoons

programme.title: The Raccoons

programme.desc: Believing Cyril is dying, Bert spends his savings on a tribute monument. When Cyril learns he is fine, he exploits the situation to sabotage the Evergreen Standard, forcing Bert to recover from his costly mistake quickly.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert and Cedric meet a hermit living in a swamp rumored to hold oil. Cyril attempts to buy the land, threatening the hermit’s home. The gang must protect the swamp and prove its worth beyond the profit Cyril seeks.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A misunderstanding leads everyone to believe Cyril is marrying Lady Baden-Baden. Cedric questions his past while Mr. Knox hides his feelings for her. As confusion grows, truths come out and relationships are tested.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: The pigs invent a time machine, which Cyril uses to alter past events for personal gain. However, his meddling causes chaos in the present, forcing the gang to fix the timeline before things spiral completely out of control.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril borrows a priceless diamond for a film, but it disappears. Bert investigates while Cyril tries to hide the loss from Lady Baden-Baden and Mr. Knox, leading to a frantic search filled with misdirection and secrets.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Adventurer Sir Malcolm invites Bert on an expedition, which Cyril secretly funds for treasure. As Bert seeks adventure and discovery, Cyril’s greed threatens the mission, putting everyone in danger along the way.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril’s failing chip business leads him to stage a fake contest to boost sales. Bert gets caught up and wastes money, realizing too late it’s a scam. The gang must expose the truth before others are tricked as well.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Daredevil biker Bix arrives and impresses Bert, but his reckless actions cause trouble that Cedric gets blamed for. Bert must recognize the difference between excitement and responsibility before friendships are damaged.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A supposed lake monster draws tourists to Evergreen Forest. Cyril exploits the craze by selling merchandise, while Bert and Melissa investigate the truth behind the sightings and reveal what is really going on.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: The pigs’ mother visits, believing her sons are wealthy. To maintain the lie, they scramble to impress her while hiding the truth. Meanwhile, Cyril faces pressure as their deception spirals out of control.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Melissa captures heroic photos of Snag and gains media attention. As fame grows, Snag is offered a TV role, but must decide if he wants the spotlight or a simpler life with his friends in the forest.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cedric attends school to build confidence but returns overly strict and changed. His new personality causes friction, and both Cyril and the Raccoons must help Cedric rediscover his true self before he loses his identity.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert finds a hidden steam train in the forest, while Cyril learns it holds a fortune. Both race to locate it first, leading to a chase where history, greed, and adventure collide deep within Evergreen Forest.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bentley runs away during a personal crisis and hides at the fort. Meanwhile, Cyril’s new security system malfunctions, trapping him inside his mansion. Both situations spiral until help arrives from unexpected places.

programme.title: High-Rise

programme.title: Desperate Hours

programme.title: Gold

programme.title: Body Of Evidence

programme.title: Femme Fatale

programme.title: Killer Joe

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Rhyme Time: If you've got a rhyme, we've got the time today, Steve is a poet and he knows it - and so are we! We play Blues Clues to figure out what Blue wants to rhyme about.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Backyard Ballgame Bonanza: If it's round and rolls, there's a good chance it belongs in Blue's Backyard Ballgame Bonanza. We're inventing all sorts of new ballgames today.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Today we're using charts to measure all sorts of things. Mr. Salt needs to figure out what everyone's favorite snack is so he can make them, so we make a chart to help him out!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Today we're painting portraits of our friends. We play Blue's Clues to figure out who else Blue wants to add to our Portrait of Pals.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Joe and Blue are playing Shape Searchers and they need our help. Blue pulls various shapes out of her bag and we look around and find things with the same shape!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: It's time to clean up because a special guest is coming over to visit! But who is it? We play Blue's Clues to figure out who our surprise guest is. While searching for clues, we straighten up the house.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We're making contraptions! Joe demonstrates his amazing "Crayon Slide" for us. Blue is making a contraption, too, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it's going to do.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Everyone is making up games today! Joe's made-up game is called Presto Change-Joe! Joe changes something about his appearance and we try to figure out what's different.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Who's got rhythm? We all do! All of our friends are making music! What instrument is Blue going to play in Blue's Big Band?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Today we're playing store! Our friends have set up pretend stores and preschoolers help Joe shop for everything on his is. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to get at the store.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Perwinkle and Blue found a bird's egg in a nest in the backyard! It's not quite ready to hatch, so we need to be patient and wait. While we wait we play Blue's Clues to figure out what to do to pass the time.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Shh! It's Joe's birthday and everyone's planning a surprise party! The characters in the house need our help to get things ready - but something is missing. Let's play Blue's Clues to figure out what else we need to do.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: All aboard! Everyone's in the backyard building an Alphabet Train. The train is made up of lots of boxes-one for each letter- and we need to help find something for each box. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what will work.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: It's a big day today - Blue's going to the doctor for her annual checkup! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do after her checkup.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Today we're counting things throughout the house and labeling them with big numbers. We learn that Joe's favorite number is one. But what's Blue's favorite? We play Blue's Clues to figure out which number is Blue's favorite!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Where is Baby Bird? Over or under Joe's head? On or off the branch? Using relational concepts, we help Joe find Baby Bird. Blue wants to find something too, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Wow, you're over pretty late today. Joe's stuffed duck Boris is ready for his favorite part of bedtime, getting tucked in, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue's favorite part of bedtime is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What's going to happen next? Some big event seems to be brewing on the patio, but we're not sure what. Blue has an idea, though, so we play Blue's Clues to predict what's going to happen on the patio.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Everybody is dressing up today! Blue is being a giraffe, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants us to be! Joe tries different costumes throughout the day - does he want to be an explorer, robot, or a duck?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We're making a giant story on the wall with pictures! It's about some rabbits who go on a trip to visit their grandma. But what will the rabbits do once they get to her house? Blue knows! We play Blue's Clues to figure it out!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Magenta is going on a trip and asked us to take care of her house while she's away! Magenta leaves us a message so we'll know what to do. Blue wants to write a message, too and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what to say.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Joe and Blue are being writers today! We're making labels for things in our house - like-hat, door, and Sidetable Drawer. Using our finger, we help Joe write letters. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to write.

programme.desc: Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.desc: Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.desc: It's Twins Day and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day Party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too -- a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

programme.desc: Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever -- and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

programme.desc: Dora and Boots are at an amusement park where they have a special wishing machine. Boots makes a wish: "I wish that when I say, 'bananas,' I get bananas." With a "boing," a bunch of bananas falls down on Boots.

programme.desc: Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the Moon before the Sun rises!

programme.desc: Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

programme.desc: Dora and Boots find a lovable little space creature named Winky. He came to visit with his family, our Purple Planet friends. But, uh oh, he's lost. We have to get Baby Winky back to his family before their spaceship takes off!

programme.desc: The Grumpy Old Troll's getting married to Petunia and we all get to be a part of this wedding! Everything's almost ready, except the Grumpy Old Troll forgot to pick up the rings from his Grandma's House! Will we make it in time for the wedding?!
programme.sub-title: The Grumpy Old Troll Gets Married

programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Wand

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are headed to a brand new playground just over the Troll Bridge. When Dora and Boots get to the Bridge, they see that the Grumpy Old Troll's missing! Map tells us that the Troll is stuck in a magic Hole!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's dance class is having a big show for all of their friends and family. Dora's starting the show and she can't wait for her family to see her dance!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
